signingInputs.observation: release-local.sh defaults the key to $HOME/.papercusp/signing/papercusp.key with an empty password. src-tauri/tauri.conf.json plugins.updater.pubkey equals the adjacent papercusp.key.pub byte-for-byte (minisign key id 5D3A7DD4A7089944). Pairing proof on a throwaway scratch file (never published, deleted afterwards): tauri signer sign with the default key and empty password exited 0; minisign -V with the pubkey decoded from tauri.conf.json reported 'Signature and comment signature verified'; after appending bytes to the scratch file, the same verify exited 1.

signingInputs.observation: Unchanged since 2026-09-14. build-windows-cross.sh decodes WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64 into a temporary PKCS#12 and signs each PE through osslsigncode; without it the build logs 'Authenticode signing DISABLED ... UNSIGNED build' and continues. Both certificate inputs are absent in this agent process.
signingInputs.remaining: An authorized Authenticode code-signing certificate (PKCS#12, base64) and its password, supplied outside the repository; then exact installer and bundled-executable Authenticode verification and a signed downloaded-install journey. No SmartScreen reputation is claimed.

signingInputs.observation: Unchanged since 2026-09-14. build-mac-cross.sh decodes MAC_SIGN_P12_BASE64 and passes it to rcodesign sign --p12-file for the .app and dmg; without it the build signs ad hoc. No maintained source step submits for notarization or staples a ticket (the only notarization text is a diagnostic note in mac-vm-fresh-install-e2e.sh).
signingInputs.remaining: An Apple Developer ID Application certificate and private key (PKCS#12, base64) with its password, plus App Store Connect API credentials for notarization, and a maintained notarize-and-staple step with its own credential contract. Then prove nested-code signing, hardened runtime, entitlements and timestamp, an accepted notary result, the stapled ticket and Gatekeeper acceptance. Rebuild downstream archives, updater signatures, hashes and provenance if that step changes bytes.
